rationale: The agent verified the user via matching email and retrieved the correct order and item. It also checked variant availability and calculated the correct price difference. However, it proceeded to perform the exchange and apply the gift card without first restating the exact change and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation, which the policy requires before any order-changing write. The user’s request even contained ambiguity about size (“could be any size at this point”), further increasing the need for confirmation. The agent also made process claims (e.g., timing of shipment/refund) without clear tool support. Due to performing the write without explicit confirmation, the conversation fails the pass criteria.
